key_insight: CLARE improves class-incremental continual learning by using a two-stage sparse adapter scheme that preserves old knowledge while adding new tasks with less interference.
engineering_relevance: For long task sequences in AI-enabled engineering systems, CLARE offers a scalable way to update shared pretrained models without repeated full retraining or severe forgetting.
method: Identify a sparse, task-critical parameter mask with a sparsity-inducing objective.
Perform mask-constrained fine-tuning, updating only the selected parameters.
Accumulate all tasks in a shared adapter space to reduce cross-task interference.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong results on the long-sequence Omnibenchmark-1k benchmark, where CLARE improves final accuracy over EASE by 4.64% and 13.34% after 100 tasks.
watch_item: The sparse-mask approach may depend on good mask selection and could be sensitive to task order or hyperparameter tuning in large-scale deployments.
paper_title: CLARE: Scalable Class-Incremental Continual Learning via a Sparsity-Based Framework
